jobs.title: Mitarbeiter:in Facility Management 80-100% - Zürich
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung
			Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams FACILITY MANAGEMENT. Als zentrale Anlaufstelle rund um Gebäude, Infrastruktur, Sicherheit und Mobilität tragen wir täglich dazu bei, dass unsere Standorte effizient, sicher und nachhaltig betrieben werden.

Übernehmen Sie bei uns Verantwortung als per Februar / März oder nach Vereinbarung:
MITARBEITER:IN FACILITY MANAGEMENT 80-100% - ZÜRICH
IHRE AUFGABEN:

• Verwaltung und Unterhalt der Firmen-Poolfahrzeuge, inklusive Organisation von Reifenwechseln, Servicearbeiten und weiteren Terminen

• Durchführung und Koordination allgemeiner Unterhaltsarbeiten im Bürogebäude, beispielsweise an Kopierern, Küchengeräten und weiteren Einrichtungen

• Beschaffung und Verwaltung der Sicherheitsausrüstung für unsere Mitarbeitenden

• Stellvertretung des Teamleiters bei Abwesenheiten

• Unterstützung des Facility-Management-Teams bei der Betreuung des Empfangsbereiches

• Unterstützung bei der internen und externen Postverwaltung

• Übernahme von Pikett-Diensten im Wechsel mit dem Team

• Aktive Mitarbeit bei Notfällen, beispielsweise bei Erste-Hilfe-Massnahmen und Evakuationen
IHRE CHANCEN:

• Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit vielfältigem Aufgabenbereich

• Selbstständiges Arbeiten mit grossem Gestaltungsspielraum und hoher Eigenverantwortung

• Kollegiales und unterstützendes Team

• Verantwortung übernehmen und den Teamleiter bei Abwesenheiten zu vertreten

• Aktive Mitgestaltung eines sicheren und funktionierenden Arbeitsumfelds für unsere Mitarbeitenden
IHR PROFIL:

• Ausbildung als Fachfrau / Fachmann Betriebsunterhalt, oder vergleichbare technische oder handwerkliche Ausbildung

• Mehrjährige Arbeitserfahrung ist von Vorteil

• Handwerkliches und technisches Verständnis

• Zuverlässige Persönlichkeit mit hoher Selbstständigkeit, Dienstleistungs- und Teamorientierung

• Organisationstalent und Freude an vielseitigen Aufgaben

• Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Pikett-Diensten

• Bereitschaft, in Notfallsituationen Verantwortung zu übernehmen

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und Grundlagen in Englisch

Werden Sie Teil der AFRY-Erfolgsgeschichte! Wir bieten Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung, kollegiale und internationale Arbeitsatmosphäre, zeitgemässe Anstellungsbedingungen, flexible Arbeitsmodelle, überdurchschnittliche Sozialleistungen, attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und grosszügige Beteiligung am ÖV Abo sowie ein Halbtax damit Sie unsere modernen Bürogebäude an zentraler Lage bestens erreichen.
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre online Bewerbung!

Unternehmensbeschreibung
			AFRY bietet Ingenieur-, Projektmanagement- und Beratungsdienstleistungen an, welche die Energiewende sowie die industrielle Transformation unterstützen und die gesellschaftliche Resilienz stärken. Mit weltweit 18.000 Expertinnen und Experten vereinen wir globale Reichweite mit lokalem Fachwissen und umfassender Branchenkenntnis, um die Zukunft kommender Generationen nachhaltig zu gestalten.
Making Future

Zusätzliche Informationen
			Bei AFRY sorgen wir bei allem, was wir tun, für Veränderungen. Denn Wandel entsteht nur, wenn mutige Ideen zusammenkommen. Wenn wir erfolgreich zusammenarbeiten, innovativ tätig sind und unterschiedliche Blickwinkel einnehmen. So gestalten wir die Zukunft. Wir sind aktiv auf der Suche nach qualifizierten Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern, die ein Teil unserer integrativen und vielfältigen Teams auf der ganzen Welt werden möchten. Schließe Dich uns an, um den Übergang zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft zu beschleunigen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione del lavoro
Diventa parte del nostro team di FACILITY MANAGEMENT. Come punto di contatto centrale per edifici, infrastrutture, sicurezza e mobilità, contribuiamo ogni giorno a garantire che le nostre sedi siano gestite in modo efficiente, sicuro e sostenibile.

Assumete la responsabilità con noi a partire da febbraio/marzo o su appuntamento:
GESTIONE DELLE STRUTTURE PER DIPENDENTI 80-100% - ZURIGO
I TUOI COMPITI:

• Amministrazione e manutenzione dei veicoli di pool aziendali, inclusa l'organizzazione dei cambi pneumatici, i lavori di assistenza e altri incarichi

• Svolgere e coordinare lavori di manutenzione generale nell'edificio degli uffici, ad esempio su fotocopiatrici, elettrodomestici da cucina e altre strutture

• Acquisto e gestione di attrezzature di sicurezza per i nostri dipendenti

• Vice capo squadra in caso di assenze

• Supporto al team di gestione della struttura nella gestione dell'area di accoglienza

• Supporto per la gestione della posta interna ed esterna

• Assunzione dei servizi di reperibilità in rotazione con il team

• Cooperazione attiva in emergenza, ad esempio nelle misure di primo soccorso e nelle evacuazioni
LE TUE OPPORTUNITÀ:

• Lavoro vario e responsabile con una vasta gamma di compiti

• Lavoro indipendente con grande libertà creativa e un alto livello di responsabilità personale

• Squadra collegiale e di supporto

• Assumiti la responsabilità e sostituisci il team leader in assenza

• Creare attivamente un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e funzionante per i nostri dipendenti
IL TUO PROFILO:

• Formazione come specialista nella manutenzione aziendale, o formazione tecnica o manuale comparabile

• Diversi anni di esperienza lavorativa sono un vantaggio

• Maestria artigianale e comprensione tecnica

• Personalità affidabile con un alto livello di indipendenza, servizio e orientamento al team

• Talento organizzativo e piacere per una varietà di compiti

• Flessibilità e disponibilità ad accettare servizi reperibili

• Disponibilità ad assumersi la responsabilità in situazioni di emergenza

• Competenze fluenti in tedesco e basi in inglese

Diventa parte della storia di successo di AFRY! Offriamo libertà creativa e responsabilità personale, un'atmosfera di lavoro collegiale e internazionale, condizioni di lavoro moderne, modelli di lavoro flessibili, benefici sociali sopra la media, opportunità di sviluppo attraenti e generosa partecipazione all'abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici, oltre a una carta di viaggio a mezza tariffa per raggiungere facilmente i nostri moderni edifici d'uffici in zone centrali.
Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online!

Descrizione dell'azienda
AFRY fornisce servizi di ingegneria, gestione di progetti e consulenza che supportano la transizione energetica e la trasformazione industriale e rafforzano la resilienza sociale. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, uniamo la portata globale con competenze locali e una vasta conoscenza del settore per rendere sostenibile il futuro delle future generazioni.
Costruire il futuro

Informazioni aggiuntive
In AFRY, creiamo cambiamento in tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché il cambiamento avviene solo quando idee audaci si uniscono. Quando lavoriamo insieme con successo, innoviamo e adottiamo prospettive diverse. È così che modelliamo il futuro. Cerchiamo attivamente candidati qualificati che vogliano far parte dei nostri team inclusivi e diversificati in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro più sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Job Description
Become part of our FACILITY MANAGEMENT team. As a central point of contact for buildings, infrastructure, security and mobility, we contribute every day to ensuring that our locations are operated efficiently, safely and sustainably.

Take on responsibility with us as per February / March or by appointment:
EMPLOYEE FACILITY MANAGEMENT 80-100% - ZURICH
YOUR TASKS:

• Administration and maintenance of the company pool vehicles, including organization of tire changes, service work and other appointments

• Carrying out and coordinating general maintenance work in the office building, for example on copiers, kitchen appliances and other facilities

• Procurement and management of safety equipment for our employees

• Deputy team leader in case of absences

• Support of the facility management team in the management of the reception area

• Support for internal and external mail management

• Assumption of on-call services in rotation with the team

• Active cooperation in emergencies, for example in first aid measures and evacuations
YOUR OPPORTUNITIES:

• Varied and responsible work with a wide range of tasks

• Independent work with great creative freedom and a high level of personal responsibility

• Collegial and supportive team

• Take responsibility and replace the team leader in absences

• Actively shaping a safe and functioning working environment for our employees
YOUR PROFILE:

• Training as a specialist in business maintenance, or comparable technical or manual training

• Several years of work experience is an advantage

• Craftsmanship and technical understanding

• Reliable personality with a high level of independence, service and team orientation

• Organizational talent and enjoyment of a variety of tasks

• Flexibility and willingness to take on on-call services

• Willingness to take responsibility in emergency situations

• Fluent German language skills and basics in English

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, modern employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in the public transport subscription as well as a Half-Fare travelcard so that you can easily reach our modern office buildings in central locations.
We look forward to receiving your online application!

Company Description
AFRY provides engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen societal resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to make the future of future generations sustainable.
Making the Future

Additional information
At AFRY, we create change in everything we do. Because change only happens when bold ideas come together. When we work together successfully, innovate and take different perspectives. That's how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates who want to become a part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

Intégrez notre équipe GESTION DES INSTALLATIONS. En tant que point de contact central pour les bâtiments, les infrastructures, la sécurité et la mobilité, nous contribuons chaque jour à garantir que nos sites soient exploités de manière efficace, sûre et durable.

GESTION DES INSTALLATIONS DES EMPLOYÉS 80-100 % - ZURICH
VOS TÂCHES :

• Administration et entretien des véhicules de la compagnie, y compris l'organisation des changements de pneus, les travaux de service et autres affectations

• Effectuer et coordonner les travaux d'entretien général dans le bâtiment de bureaux, par exemple sur les photocopieuses, les appareils de cuisine et d'autres installations

• Acquisition et gestion du matériel de sécurité pour nos employés

• Chef adjoint d'équipe en cas d'absences

• Soutien de l'équipe de gestion des installations dans la gestion de la zone d'accueil

• Prise en charge de la gestion du courrier interne et externe

• Prise en charge des services de garde en rotation avec l'équipe

• Coopération active en cas d'urgence, par exemple dans les mesures de premiers secours et les évacuations
VOS OPPORTUNITÉS :

• Un travail varié et responsable avec un large éventail de tâches

• Travail indépendant avec une grande liberté créative et un haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle

• Équipe collégiale et de soutien

• Prenez vos responsabilités et remplacez le chef d'équipe en absence.

• Façonner activement un environnement de travail sûr et fonctionnel pour nos employés
VOTRE PROFIL :

• Formation en tant que spécialiste en maintenance d'entreprise, ou une formation technique ou manuelle comparable

• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle sont un avantage

• Savoir-faire et compréhension technique

• Personnalité fiable avec un haut niveau d'autonomie, de service et d'orientation d'équipe

• Talent organisationnel et plaisir de diverses tâches

• Flexibilité et volonté de prendre en charge des services d'astreinte

• Volonté d'assumer la responsabilité en situation d'urgence

• Maîtrise de l'allemand et notions de base en anglais

Devenez partie intégrante de l'histoire à succès de l'AFRY ! Nous offrons une liberté créative et une responsabilité personnelle, une atmosphère de travail collégiale et internationale, des conditions d'emploi modernes, des modèles de travail flexibles, des avantages sociaux supérieurs à la moyenne, des opportunités de développement attractives et une participation généreuse aux abonnements aux transports en commun ainsi qu'une carte de voyage à demi-tarif afin que vous puissiez facilement accéder à nos immeubles de bureaux modernes situés au centre.
Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne !

Description de l'entreprise
AFRY fournit des services d'ingénierie, de gestion de projet et de conseil qui soutiennent la transition énergétique et la transformation industrielle et renforcent la résilience sociétale. Avec 18 000 experts dans le monde, nous combinons une portée mondiale avec une expertise locale et une vaste connaissance du secteur pour rendre l'avenir des générations futures durable.
Créer l'avenir

Informations complémentaires
Chez AFRY, nous créons du changement dans tout ce que nous faisons. Parce que le changement n'arrive que lorsque des idées audacieuses prennent forme. Quand nous travaillons ensemble avec succès, innovons et adoptons des perspectives différentes. C'est ainsi que nous façonnons l'avenir. Nous recherchons activement des candidats qualifiés qui souhaitent faire partie de nos équipes inclusives et diversifiées à travers le monde. Rejoignez-nous pour accélérer la transition vers un avenir plus durable.

jobs.title: Global Sales Manager Segment Hydro (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description
			Hydropower plays a vital role in the global energy transition, providing renewable, reliable and flexible energy to power systems worldwide. At AFRY, our Hydro experts support clients across the entire project lifecycle, combining deep technical expertise with extensive international experience

GLOBAL SALES MANAGER SEGMENT HYDRO (f/m/d)
The work location is flexible and will be agreed upon based on the candidate's profile.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Drive sales activities across the full Hydro service portfolio, with a particular focus on strategic, global and cross-regional opportunities

• Identify, develop and pursue new business opportunities in collaboration with Regional Directors and operational teams

• Build and maintain senior-level relationships with key strategic clients

• Promote Hydro’s global capabilities and foster collaboration across regions

• Contribute to the execution of Hydro’s commercial strategy in close cooperation with the Segment Head and Regional Directors

• Provide market and client insights to support commercial priorities and business development activities
YOUR OPPORTUNITIES:

• Shape the future growth of AFRY's global Hydro business

• Make a visible impact on strategic business opportunities worldwide

• Collaborate with colleagues, experts, and clients internationally

• Build strong relationships with key industry stakeholders

• Drive strategic business opportunities across regions

• Work with passionate colleagues in a truly global environment

• Contribute to sustainable energy projects and the hydropower transition worldwide
YOUR PROFILE:

• Degree in Engineering, Business, Economics or in a related field

• Significant experience in international B2B sales, business development, or commercial management, preferably in engineering, consulting, energy or infrastructure

• Proven track record in managing complex international sales opportunities including commercial negotiations and client relationships

• Experience in international and matrix organizations

• Leadership experience with the ability to motivate and guide teams

• Good understanding of CRM systems and structured sales processes

• Knowledge of the hydropower sector and its international client landscape is a strong advantage

• Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset

• Willingness and ability to travel internationally

As Global Sales Manager Segment Hydro, you will play a key role in driving the growth of AFRY’s Hydro business worldwide. You will identify new business opportunities, build strategic client relationships, and connect expertise across AFRY. Working closely with our regional and global teams, you will help shape our market presence, deliver value to our clients and contribute to the development of our Hydro business worldwide.

We look forward to receiving your online application!

Company Description
			AFRY provides engineering, project management, and advisory services that enable the energy and industrial transition and strengthen resilience in society. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine a global reach with local insights and deep sector knowledge to make a lasting impact for generations to come.
Making Future

Additional Information
			At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione del lavoro
L'energia idroelettrica svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella transizione energetica globale, fornendo energia rinnovabile, affidabile e flessibile ai sistemi energetici di tutto il mondo. In AFRY, i nostri esperti idroelettrici supportano i clienti durante tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto, combinando una profonda competenza tecnica con una vasta esperienza internazionale

RESPONSABILE VENDITE GLOBALE NEL SEGMENTO HYDRO (m/f/d)
La sede di lavoro è flessibile e sarà concordata in base al profilo del candidato.
LE TUE RESPONSABILITÀ:

• Promuovere le attività di vendita in tutto il portafoglio servizi Hydro, con particolare attenzione a opportunità strategiche, globali e interregionali

• Identificare, sviluppare e perseguire nuove opportunità di business in collaborazione con i Direttori Regionali e i team operativi

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni di alto livello con clienti strategici chiave

• Promuovere le capacità globali di Hydro e favorire la collaborazione tra le regioni

• Contribuire all'esecuzione della strategia commerciale di Hydro in stretta collaborazione con il Capo Segmento e i Direttori Regionali

• Fornire informazioni sul mercato e sui clienti per supportare le priorità commerciali e le attività di sviluppo del business
LE TUE OPPORTUNITÀ:

• Plasmare la crescita futura del business idroelettrico globale di AFRY

• Avere un impatto visibile sulle opportunità di business strategiche a livello mondiale

• Collaborare con colleghi, esperti e clienti a livello internazionale

• Costruire solide relazioni con i principali stakeholder del settore

• Generare opportunità di business strategiche tra le regioni

• Lavora con colleghi appassionati in un ambiente davvero globale

• Contribuire a progetti energetici sostenibili e alla transizione idroelettrica a livello mondiale
IL TUO PROFILO:

• Laurea in Ingegneria, Economia, Economia o in un campo correlato

• Significativa esperienza nelle vendite B2B internazionali, sviluppo commerciale o gestione commerciale, preferibilmente in ingegneria, consulenza, energia o infrastrutture

• Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di complesse opportunità di vendita internazionali, incluse negoziazioni commerciali e relazioni con i clienti

• Esperienza in organizzazioni internazionali e matriciali

• Esperienza di leadership con la capacità di motivare e guidare i team

• Buona comprensione dei sistemi CRM e dei processi di vendita strutturati

• La conoscenza del settore idroelettrico e del suo panorama internazionale di clienti è un grande vantaggio

• Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio

• Disponibilità e capacità di viaggiare all'estero

Come Global Sales Manager Segment Hydro, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel guidare la crescita del business Hydro di AFRY a livello mondiale. Identificherai nuove opportunità di business, costruirai relazioni strategiche con i clienti e collegherai le competenze in tutto AFRY. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i nostri team regionali e globali, contribuirai a definire la nostra presenza sul mercato, offrirai valore ai nostri clienti e contribuirai allo sviluppo del nostro business Hydro a livello globale.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online!

Descrizione dell'azienda
AFRY fornisce servizi di ingegneria, gestione di progetti e consulenza che favoriscono la transizione energetica e industriale e rafforzano la resilienza della società. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, combiniamo una portata globale con approfondimenti locali e profonda conoscenza del settore per lasciare un impatto duraturo per le generazioni future.
Costruire il futuro

Informazioni aggiuntive
In AFRY, generiamo il cambiamento in tutto ciò che facciamo. Il cambiamento avviene quando idee coraggiose si uniscono. Quando collaboriamo, innoviamo la tecnologia e abbracciamo punti di vista impegnativi. È così che costruiamo il futuro. Stiamo attivamente cercando candidati qualificati per unirsi ai nostri team inclusivi e diversificati in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro sostenibile.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description du poste
L'hydroélectricité joue un rôle essentiel dans la transition énergétique mondiale, fournissant une énergie renouvelable, fiable et flexible aux systèmes électriques du monde entier. Chez AFRY, nos experts hydroélectriques accompagnent les clients tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, alliant une expertise technique approfondie à une vaste expérience internationale

DIRECTEUR COMMERCIAL MONDIAL DU SEGMENT HYDRO (h/f/d)
Le lieu de travail est flexible et sera convenu en fonction du profil du candidat.
VOS RESPONSABILITÉS :

• Stimuler les activités commerciales sur l'ensemble du portefeuille de services hydroélectriques, avec un accent particulier sur les opportunités stratégiques, mondiales et interrégionales

• Identifier, développer et poursuivre de nouvelles opportunités commerciales en collaboration avec les directeurs régionaux et les équipes opérationnelles

• Construire et maintenir des relations de haut niveau avec des clients stratégiques clés

• Promouvoir les capacités mondiales de Hydro et favoriser la collaboration entre les régions

• Contribuer à l'exécution de la stratégie commerciale d'Hydro en étroite collaboration avec le chef de segment et les directeurs régionaux

• Fournir des informations sur le marché et les clients pour soutenir les priorités commerciales et les activités de développement commercial
VOS OPPORTUNITÉS :

• Façonner la croissance future de l'activité hydroélectrique mondiale d'AFRY

• Avoir un impact visible sur les opportunités d'affaires stratégiques à l'échelle mondiale

• Collaborer avec des collègues, des experts et des clients à l’échelle internationale

• Construire des relations solides avec les principaux acteurs du secteur

• Générer des opportunités d'affaires stratégiques à travers les régions

• Travailler avec des collègues passionnés dans un environnement véritablement mondial

• Contribuer aux projets d'énergie durable et à la transition de l'hydroélectricité dans le monde entier
VOTRE PROFIL :

• Diplôme en ingénierie, commerce, économie ou dans un domaine connexe

• Expérience significative dans la vente B2B internationale, le développement commercial ou la gestion commerciale, de préférence dans l'ingénierie, le conseil, l'énergie ou les infrastructures

• Un parcours éprouvé dans la gestion d'opportunités de vente internationales complexes, y compris des négociations commerciales et des relations clients

• Expérience dans les organisations internationales et matriciales

• Expérience en leadership avec la capacité de motiver et de guider les équipes

• Bonne compréhension des systèmes CRM et des processus de vente structurés

• La connaissance du secteur hydroélectrique et de son paysage de clients internationaux constitue un atout majeur

• Maîtrise l'anglais ; les langues supplémentaires sont un atout

• Volonté et capacité à voyager à l'international

En tant que Directeur Commercial Mondial du Segment Hydro, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la croissance de l'activité Hydro d'AFRY à l'échelle mondiale. Vous identifierez de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, construirez des relations stratégiques avec vos clients et mettrez en relation l'expertise à travers AFRY. En travaillant étroitement avec nos équipes régionales et mondiales, vous contribuerez à façonner notre présence sur le marché, à apporter de la valeur à nos clients et à contribuer au développement de notre activité Hydro à l'échelle mondiale.

Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne !

Description de l'entreprise
AFRY fournit des services d'ingénierie, de gestion de projet et de conseil qui favorisent la transition énergétique et industrielle et renforcent la résilience de la société. Avec 18 000 experts dans le monde, nous allions une portée mondiale à des connaissances locales et à une connaissance approfondie du secteur pour avoir un impact durable sur les générations à venir.
Créer l'avenir

Informations complémentaires
Chez AFRY, nous provoquons le changement dans tout ce que nous faisons. Le changement survient lorsque des idées courageuses se rencontrent. Quand nous collaborons, innovons dans la technologie et adoptons des points de vue stimulants. C'est ainsi que nous construisons l'avenir. Nous recherchons activement des candidats qualifiés pour rejoindre nos équipes inclusives et diversifiées à travers le monde. Rejoignez-nous pour accélérer la transition vers un avenir durable.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione del lavoro
Diventa parte del nostro team di ingegneria strutturale. Puoi aspettarti una vasta gamma di nuovi progetti di costruzione e riparazione impegnativi nei settori dell'edilizia, ingegneria civile, infrastrutture ferroviarie, costruzioni industriali e produzione di energia. I nostri clienti includono aziende private, così come il governo federale, cantoni, comuni e operatori infrastrutturali.
Assumiti la responsabilità con noi:

PROJECT MANAGER INGEGNERIA STRUTTURALE 80-100% - ZURICH
I TUOI COMPITI:

• Gestione di progetti di nuove costruzioni e conversioni versatili e impegnative, dalla pianificazione del progetto all'entrata in servizio

• Progettazione di concetti strutturali e soluzioni strutturali per nuovi edifici e ristrutturazioni in collaborazione con clienti, architetti o specialisti di altri dipartimenti di AFRY

• Elaborazione delle questioni geotecniche con la pianificazione del progetto e l'attuazione di scavi, fondazioni degli edifici e stabilizzazione del terreno

• Gestione del progetto in conformità con i costi e gli obiettivi di qualità e scadenze

• Leadership e supporto tecnico del team di progetto

• Supporto ai capi team e dipartimento nell'acquisizione di nuovi progetti

• Supporto al capo dipartimento nel mantenere i contatti esistenti e nell'instaurazione di nuovi contatti con i clienti
LE TUE OPPORTUNITÀ:

• Ampliamento dell'esperienza come ingegnere strutturale nel lavoro interdisciplinare di progetti

• Lavorare con applicazioni e metodi di progettazione all'avanguardia (BIM, BIM2Field)

• Una stretta collaborazione con specialisti di altri dipartimenti e sezioni ti permette di svilupparti personalmente

• Modalità flessibile di lavorare con infrastrutture moderne e la possibilità di lavorare da casa

• Opportunità di sviluppo nell'organizzazione come specialista o in linea
IL TUO PROFILO:

• Completato gli studi come ingegnere laureato o master in ingegneria civile (ETH/FH/TU)

• Ottime capacità di comunicazione orale e scritta in tedesco

• Conoscenza approfondita nel campo della statica/costruzione di costruzioni solide, in acciaio e legno, nel campo della geotecnica e della tecnologia delle fondazioni, nonché nell'uso dei relativi software di calcolo FEM (SOFiSTiK, AxisVM, CUBUS)

• Diversi anni di esperienza nella pianificazione di progetti come ingegnere o manager di progetto in pianificazione strutturale in tutte le fasi di pianificazione e implementazione del progetto

• Talento per la progettazione e l'implementazione di strutture efficienti ed economiche e per l'applicazione di strumenti di progettazione moderni

• Ti motiva a pianificare e implementare progetti digitalmente, ad esempio nell'applicazione del metodo BIM e degli strumenti di coordinamento 3D

• Personalità comunicativa, orientata alle soluzioni e al cliente, oltre che imprenditoriale

Diventa parte della storia di successo di AFRY! Offriamo libertà creativa e responsabilità personale, un'atmosfera di lavoro collegiale e internazionale, condizioni di lavoro moderne, modelli di lavoro flessibili, benefici sociali sopra la media, opportunità di sviluppo attraenti e generosa partecipazione all'abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici, oltre a una carta di viaggio a mezza tariffa per raggiungere facilmente i nostri moderni edifici d'uffici in zone centrali.
Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online!

Descrizione dell'azienda
AFRY fornisce servizi di ingegneria, gestione di progetti e consulenza che supportano la transizione energetica e la trasformazione industriale e rafforzano la resilienza sociale. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, uniamo la portata globale con competenze locali e una vasta conoscenza del settore per rendere sostenibile il futuro delle future generazioni.
Costruire il futuro

Informazioni aggiuntive
In AFRY, creiamo cambiamento in tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché il cambiamento avviene solo quando idee audaci si uniscono. Quando lavoriamo insieme con successo, innoviamo e adottiamo prospettive diverse. È così che modelliamo il futuro. Cerchiamo attivamente candidati qualificati che vogliano far parte dei nostri team inclusivi e diversificati in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro più sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Job Description
			Become part of our structural engineering team. You can expect a wide range of challenging new construction and repair projects in the fields of building construction, civil engineering, railway infrastructure, industrial construction and energy production. Our customers include private companies as well as the federal government, cantons, municipalities and infrastructure operators.
Take on responsibility with us as:

PROJECT MANAGER STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING ENGINEERING 80-100% - ZURICH
YOUR TASKS:

• Project management of versatile and challenging new construction and conversion projects from project planning to commissioning

• Design of structural concepts and structural solutions for new buildings and renovations in cooperation with clients, architects or specialists from other departments of AFRY

• Processing of geotechnical issues with project planning and implementation of excavations, building foundations and terrain stabilization

• Project management in compliance with cost, quality and deadline targets

• Leadership and technical support of the project team

• Support of team and department heads in the acquisition of new projects

• Support of the head of department in maintaining existing and establishing new customer contacts
YOUR OPPORTUNITIES:

• Expansion of experience as a structural engineer in interdisciplinary project work

• Working with state-of-the-art design applications and methods (BIM, BIM2Field)

• Close cooperation with specialists from other departments and branches enables you to develop personally

• Flexible way of working with modern infrastructure and the possibility of working from home

• Development opportunities in the organization as a specialist or in the line
YOUR PROFILE:

• Completed studies as a graduate engineer or master's degree in civil engineering (ETH/FH/TU)

• Very good oral and written communication skills in German

• In-depth knowledge in the field of statics / construction of solid, steel and timber constructions, in the field of geotechnics and foundation technology as well as in the use of corresponding FEM calculation software (SOFiSTiK, AxisVM, CUBUS)

• Several years of project planning experience as a project engineer or manager in structural planning across all project planning and implementation phases

• Flair for the design and implementation of efficient and economical structures and the application of modern design tools

• Motivates you to plan and implement projects digitally, e.g. in the application of the BIM method and 3D coordination tools

• Communicative, solution- and customer-oriented as well as entrepreneurially minded personality

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, modern employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in the public transport subscription as well as a Half-Fare travelcard so that you can easily reach our modern office buildings in central locations.
We look forward to receiving your online application!

Company Description
			AFRY provides engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen societal resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to make the future of future generations sustainable.
Making the Future

Additional information
			At AFRY, we create change in everything we do. Because change only happens when bold ideas come together. When we work together successfully, innovate and take different perspectives. That's how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates who want to become a part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Job description
			Join our PROCUREMENT & NETWORKS team. We lead, develop, design and plan national infrastructure and energy projects. We support these projects from the planning phase to their completion. Taking environmental issues into account, we carry out our projects in an environmentally friendly and sustainable way.

Come and join and strengthen our team by taking on the following responsibility:
PROJECT MANAGER AND WORKS MANAGER - HIGH VOLTAGE POWER LINE CONSTRUCTION - SUPPLY & (m/f/d) 80-100% NETWORKS - LAUSANNE
 (overhead and underground high-voltage lines)
YOUR TASKS:

• Responsibility for the planning and monitoring of demanding projects, with particular attention to the construction of overhead lines and high-voltage cables, from design to completion

• Autonomous execution of the technical tasks of the project, including coordination of the development of plans and models, participation in technical and coordination meetings, and preparation of calculations and reports

• Development of schedules and cost estimates

• Preparation of tender documents for our clients' construction projects

• Technical management of works for high and very high voltage lines, with particular attention to overhead and underground lines

• Coordination and control of the work on site until commissioning

• Nationwide displacement (approx. 10-20%)
YOUR CHANCES:

• Development of the engineering team for French-speaking Switzerland with the possibility of becoming the future team leader.

• Collaboration, knowledge sharing and mutual support are the pillars on which our way of working is based

• Varied and interdisciplinary projects, in collaboration with specialists from different fields

• A diverse team, bringing together various professional backgrounds

• One-on-one support, whether through targeted training or professional development opportunities

• Flexible working models, with the possibility of teleworking, as well as a modern infrastructure, all in a central location
YOUR PROFILE:

• Electrical Engineering Engineer (BSc/MSc) or equivalent

• At least three years' professional experience in electrical engineering, with a focus on the construction of high-voltage overhead and underground lines

• Good knowledge of MS Office; knowledge of PLS-CADD, EFC-400, FM-Profil and AutoCAD, or comparable CAD systems is an asset

• Experience with BIM (Building Information Modeling) methodology is an asset

• Customer-oriented mindset and the pleasure of collaborating within a team

• Very good knowledge of French, oral and written (min. C1)

• Knowledge of other languages (German, Italian, English) is an asset

• Reliable, autonomous and precise way of working

Contribute to AFRY's success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, contemporary employment conditions, flexible working arrangements, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities as well as a generous contribution to the local public transport season ticket and the half-fare travelcard, so that you can easily reach our modern and well-connected offices.
We look forward to your online application!

Company Description
			AFRY offers engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation, while strengthening the resilience of society. With 18,000 experts around the world, we combine a global presence with local expertise and in-depth knowledge of different industries, to sustainably shape the future of future generations.
Making Future

			At AFRY, we are change engineers in everything we do. Change happens when courageous ideas meet. When we collaborate, innovate in technology, and take challenging perspectives. That's how we build the future. We actively seek qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us in accelerating the transition to a sustainable future.

Descrizione del lavoro
			Diventa parte del nostro team SUPPLY & GRIDS. Guidiamo, sviluppiamo, progettiamo e pianifichiamo progetti infrastrutturali e energetici nazionali. Accompagniamo questi progetti dalla pianificazione all'attuazione. Includendo le questioni ambientali, realizziamo i nostri progetti in modo ecologico e sostenibile.

Assumiti la responsabilità con noi:
RESPONSABILE DI PROGETTO E COSTRUZIONE PER LA COSTRUZIONE DI LINEE AD ALTA TENSIONE - UTILITIES & GRIDS 80-100% - ZURIGO
 (alta tensione, linee aeree e cavi)
I TUOI COMPITI:

• Responsabile della pianificazione e supervisione di progetti impegnativi con particolare attenzione alla costruzione di linee aeree e cavi ad alta tensione dallo studio all'implementazione

• Esecuzione indipendente dei compiti tecnici del progetto, inclusa la coordinazione della creazione del modello, partecipazione a riunioni tecniche e di coordinamento, preparazione di calcoli e report

• Preparazione di scadenze e piani di costo

• Preparazione dei documenti di gara per i progetti di costruzione dei nostri clienti

• Gestione specialistica della costruzione per linee ad alta tensione e extra-alta tensione con particolare attenzione alla costruzione di linee aeree e cavi

• Coordinamento e controllo dei lavori nel cantiere fino all'entrata in servizio

• Attività di viaggio nazionali (circa 10-20%)
LE TUE OPPORTUNITÀ:

• Il supporto reciproco, il trasferimento di conoscenze e la cooperazione sono fondamentali fondamentali del nostro modo di lavorare

• Progetti vari e interdisciplinari, così come con dipendenti di diversi dipartimenti

• Team diversificato con diversi background professionali

• Supporto e incoraggiamento individuali: sia attraverso formazione mirata sia opportunità di sviluppo professionale

• Modelli di lavoro flessibili con la possibilità di lavorare da casa e un'infrastruttura moderna in una posizione centrale
IL TUO PROFILO:

• Ingegnere elettrico (BSc / MSc) o formazione comparabile

• I laureati universitari con motivazione e voglia di imparare sono i benvenuti

• L'esperienza professionale in ingegneria elettrica e soprattutto nella costruzione di linee aeree e cavi è un vantaggio

• Buone competenze in MS Office, la conoscenza di AutoCad, REVIT, Civil 3D o sistemi CAD simili sono un vantaggio

• L'esperienza nella gestione della metodologia BIM (Building Information Modeling) è un vantaggio

• Pensiero orientato al cliente e piacere di lavorare insieme in squadra

• Ottime competenze di tedesco scritto e parlato (almeno C1)

• Le competenze linguistiche straniere (francese, italiano, inglese) rappresentano un vantaggio

• Modo di lavorare affidabile, indipendente e preciso

Diventa parte della storia di successo di AFRY! Offriamo libertà creativa e responsabilità personale, un'atmosfera di lavoro collegiale e internazionale, condizioni di lavoro moderne, modelli di lavoro flessibili, benefici sociali sopra la media, opportunità di sviluppo attraenti e generosa partecipazione all'abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici, oltre a una carta di viaggio a mezza tariffa per raggiungere facilmente i nostri moderni edifici d'uffici in zone centrali.
Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online!

Descrizione dell'azienda
			AFRY fornisce servizi di ingegneria, gestione di progetti e consulenza che supportano la transizione energetica e la trasformazione industriale e rafforzano la resilienza sociale. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, uniamo la portata globale con competenze locali e una vasta conoscenza del settore per rendere sostenibile il futuro delle future generazioni.
Costruire il futuro

Informazioni aggiuntive
			In AFRY, creiamo cambiamento in tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché il cambiamento avviene solo quando idee audaci si uniscono. Quando lavoriamo insieme con successo, innoviamo e adottiamo prospettive diverse. È così che modelliamo il futuro. Cerchiamo attivamente candidati qualificati che vogliano far parte dei nostri team inclusivi e diversificati in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro più sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Job Description
			Become part of our SUPPLY & GRIDS team. We lead, develop, design and plan national infrastructure and energy projects. We accompany these projects from planning to implementation. By including environmental issues, we implement our projects in an environmentally friendly and sustainable way.

Take on responsibility with us as:
PROJECT AND CONSTRUCTION MANAGER FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF HIGH-VOLTAGE LINES - UTILITIES & GRIDS 80-100% - ZURICH
 (high-voltage, overhead and cable lines)
YOUR TASKS:

• Responsible for the planning and supervision of demanding projects with a focus on high-voltage overhead line and cable construction from study to implementation

• Independent execution of technical project tasks, including coordination of model creation, participation in technical and coordination meetings, preparation of calculations and reports

• Preparation of deadlines and cost plans

• Preparation of tender documents for our customers' construction projects

• Specialist construction management for high-voltage and extra-high-voltage lines with a focus on overhead line and cable construction

• Coordination and control of work on the construction site up to commissioning

• National travel activities (approx. 10-20%)
YOUR OPPORTUNITIES:

• Mutual support, knowledge transfer and cooperation are important cornerstones of our way of working

• Varied and interdisciplinary projects as well as with employees from different departments

• Diverse team with different professional backgrounds

• Individual support and encouragement: whether through targeted training or opportunities for professional development

• Flexible working models with the possibility of working from home as well as a modern infrastructure in a central location
YOUR PROFILE:

• Electrical engineer (BSc / MSc) or comparable education

• University graduates with motivation and willingness to learn are welcome

• Professional experience in electrical engineering and especially in overhead line and cable construction is an advantage

• Good MS Office skills, knowledge of AutoCad, REVIT, Civil 3D or comparable CAD systems is an advantage

• Experience in dealing with BIM (Building Information Modeling) methodology is an advantage

• Customer-oriented thinking and enjoyment of working together in a team

• Very good written and spoken German skills (at least C1)

• Foreign language skills (French, Italian, English) are an advantage

• Reliable, independent and precise way of working

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, modern employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in the public transport subscription as well as a Half-Fare travelcard so that you can easily reach our modern office buildings in central locations.
We look forward to receiving your online application!

Company Description
			AFRY provides engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen societal resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to make the future of future generations sustainable.
Making the Future

Additional information
			At AFRY, we create change in everything we do. Because change only happens when bold ideas come together. When we work together successfully, innovate and take different perspectives. That's how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates who want to become a part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description du poste
			Rejoignez notre équipe SUPPLY & GRIDS. Nous dirigeons, développons, concevons et planifions des projets nationaux d'infrastructures et d'énergie. Nous accompagnons ces projets de la planification à la mise en œuvre. En intégrant les questions environnementales, nous mettons en œuvre nos projets de manière respectueuse de l'environnement et durable.

Assumez la responsabilité avec nous en tant que :
CHEF DE PROJET ET DE CONSTRUCTION POUR LA CONSTRUCTION DE LIGNES À HAUTE TENSION - SERVICES PUBLICS ET RÉSEAUX 80-100 % - ZÜRICH
 (haute tension, lignes aériennes et câbles)
VOS TÂCHES :

• Responsable de la planification et de la supervision de projets exigeants, avec un accent sur la construction de lignes aériennes et de câbles à haute tension, de l'étude à la mise en œuvre

• Exécution indépendante des tâches techniques du projet, y compris la coordination de la création du modèle, la participation à des réunions techniques et de coordination, la préparation de calculs et de rapports

• Élaboration des échéances et des plans de coûts

• Préparation des documents d'appel d'offres pour les projets de construction de nos clients

• Gestion spécialisée de la construction pour les lignes haute tension et extra-haute tension, avec un accent sur la construction de lignes aériennes et de câbles

• Coordination et contrôle des travaux sur le chantier jusqu'à la mise en service

• Activités de voyage nationales (environ 10-20 %)
VOS OPPORTUNITÉS :

• Le soutien mutuel, le transfert de connaissances et la coopération sont des pierres angulaires importantes de notre mode de travail

• Des projets variés et interdisciplinaires ainsi qu'avec des employés de différents départements

• Équipe diversifiée avec des parcours professionnels différents

• Soutien individuel et encouragement : que ce soit par des formations ciblées ou des opportunités de développement professionnel

• Des modèles de travail flexibles avec la possibilité de télétravail ainsi qu'une infrastructure moderne dans un emplacement central
VOTRE PROFIL :

• Ingénieur électricien (BSc / MSc) ou formation comparable

• Les diplômés universitaires motivés et désireux d'apprendre sont les bienvenus

• L'expérience professionnelle en génie électrique, et surtout dans la construction de lignes aériennes et de câbles, est un atout

• De bonnes compétences en MS Office, ainsi que la connaissance d'AutoCad, REVIT, Civil 3D ou de systèmes CAD comparables sont un avantage

• L'expérience dans la méthodologie BIM (Modélisation de l'Information de Bâtiment) est un atout

• Pensée orientée client et plaisir de travailler ensemble en équipe

• Très bonnes compétences en allemand écrit et parlé (au moins C1)

• Les compétences en langues étrangères (français, italien, anglais) sont un avantage

• Un mode de travail fiable, indépendant et précis

Devenez partie intégrante de l'histoire à succès de l'AFRY ! Nous offrons une liberté créative et une responsabilité personnelle, une atmosphère de travail collégiale et internationale, des conditions d'emploi modernes, des modèles de travail flexibles, des avantages sociaux supérieurs à la moyenne, des opportunités de développement attractives et une participation généreuse aux abonnements aux transports en commun ainsi qu'une carte de voyage à demi-tarif afin que vous puissiez facilement accéder à nos immeubles de bureaux modernes situés au centre.
Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature en ligne !

Description de l'entreprise
			AFRY fournit des services d'ingénierie, de gestion de projet et de conseil qui soutiennent la transition énergétique et la transformation industrielle et renforcent la résilience sociétale. Avec 18 000 experts dans le monde, nous combinons une portée mondiale avec une expertise locale et une vaste connaissance du secteur pour rendre l'avenir des générations futures durable.
Créer l'avenir

Informations complémentaires
			Chez AFRY, nous créons du changement dans tout ce que nous faisons. Parce que le changement n'arrive que lorsque des idées audacieuses prennent forme. Quand nous travaillons ensemble avec succès, innovons et adoptons des perspectives différentes. C'est ainsi que nous façonnons l'avenir. Nous recherchons activement des candidats qualifiés qui souhaitent faire partie de nos équipes inclusives et diversifiées à travers le monde. Rejoignez-nous pour accélérer la transition vers un avenir plus durable.

Job description
			Come and join and strengthen our WATER/ENVIRONMENT team. We support national and international infrastructure and energy projects with the aim of improving the efficiency of energy, water and materials cycles.

Come and join and strengthen our team and take on responsibilities such as:
PROJECT MANAGER WATER AND WASTEWATER 80-100% (M/F/D) – LAUSANNE
YOUR TASKS:

• Manage and carry out large-scale projects for the construction of water treatment plants for municipalities and industrialists, from concept to completion

• Tracking project costs, timelines, and quality

• Coordinate specialists (processes, hydraulics, electromechanics, CVS, EMCR, civil engineering, architect) during the design, execution and/or construction phases

• Produce and control technical documents (plans, process diagrams, etc.)

• Perform budget estimates

• Report writing and technical document development

• Management of public and private calls for tenders

• Works management, site monitoring, coordination of stakeholders

• Maintain and develop relationships with customers, operators and partners

• Participation in acquisition tasks
YOUR PROFILE:

• Training as an Environmental, Process/Chemical, Civil or Hydraulic Engineering (EPFL / ETH or equivalent)

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a process / project / execution / implementation engineer

• Proven experience in managing multidisciplinary projects

• Be part of a dynamic team dealing with projects of all sizes, always putting the client and the quality of their work first

• Transversal vision of projects and ideally familiar with SIA and VSA standards

• Fluency in oral and written French, ideally with a good knowledge of German

Contribute to AFRY's success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, contemporary employment conditions, flexible work organization, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities as well as a generous contribution to the public transport subscription and a half-fare travelcard so that you can easily reach our modern and easily accessible offices.
We look forward to your online application!

			AFRY offers engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy and industrial transition, while helping to build resilience in our societies. With 18,000 experts around the world, we combine international reach with in-depth knowledge of diverse local and industrial contexts, to generate a sustainable impact for future generations.
Making Future

That's how we build the future. We actively seek qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us in accelerating the transition to a sustainable future.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione del lavoro
			Diventa parte del nostro team ACQUA & AMBIENTE. Pianifichiamo e implementiamo impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue con tecnologie all'avanguardia per l'ulteriore eliminazione dei nutrienti e la rimozione di sostanze organiche in tracce. Inoltre, minimizziamo il consumo energetico, utilizziamo le acque reflue come risorsa e chiudiamo i cicli dei materiali per soluzioni sostenibili. Supportaci nella pianificazione e nell'implementazione dei progetti di impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue. Pianifica con noi le infrastrutture sostenibili di domani, che contribuiscano a migliorare la qualità dell'acqua nei fiumi e nei laghi e allo stesso tempo ispirano i nostri clienti con soluzioni innovative e orientate al cliente.
Assumiti la responsabilità con noi:
PROJECT MANAGER INGEGNERIA CIVILE NEL CAMPO DELLE ACQUE E DELLE ACQUE REFLUE 80-100% - ZURIGO
Modellate le infrastrutture idriche di domani
Gli impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue e i sistemi di drenaggio urbano sono tra i progetti infrastrutturali più impegnativi: combinano ingegneria strutturale e civile, ingegneria strutturale, ingegneria di processo, ingegneria meccanica e tecnologia edilizia – spesso durante il funzionamento continuo e sotto elevate richieste di qualità, scadenze e costi.
In AFRY, avrai un ruolo centrale in questi progetti. Svilupperai concetti di costruzione, coordinerai team di pianificazione interdisciplinari e accompagnerai i nostri clienti dall'idea iniziale fino all'implementazione di successo.
Non lavori da solo: nel nostro team Acqua e Ambiente incontrerai specialisti esperti che condividono le loro conoscenze, si assumono responsabilità e si sostengono a vicenda.
I TUOI COMPITI:

• Pianificazione e realizzazione di lavori edilizi sofisticati e di ingegneria civile e sviluppo di soluzioni innovative ed economiche per gli operatori di impianti di trattamento delle acque reflue e sistemi di drenaggio urbano

• Assumere la gestione complessiva o del sottoprogetto e controllare qualità, costi, scadenze e rischi

• Coordinamento di team di progetto interdisciplinari e guida le interfacce con ingegneria strutturale, ingegneria di processo, architettura, ingegneria meccanica, tecnologia edilizia e EI&C

• Consigliamo e accompagniamo i nostri clienti e rappresentiamo i progetti davanti a proprietari di edifici, autorità, parti urbanistiche e aziende esecutrici in tutte le fasi di pianificazione SIA
COSA POTETE ASPETTARVI DA NOI:

• Una squadra ben allenata ed esperta

• Progetti complessi con richieste tecniche e impatto

• Libertà di iniziativa e responsabilità

• Cooperazione interdisciplinare all'altezza degli occhi

• Promozione dei propri punti di forza individuali

• Modelli di lavoro flessibili e contemporanei
IL TUO PROFILO:

• Laurea in ingegneria civile, architettura o un campo comparabile

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale (almeno 5 anni) nella pianificazione e realizzazione di progetti infrastrutturali, industriali o edilizi

• Esperienza idealmente nel campo dell'acqua e delle acque reflue, nell'ingegneria strutturale, nell'ingegneria strutturale o nella gestione specialistica delle costruzioni

• Interesse per questioni interdisciplinari e piacere nel lavorare con diversi dipartimenti

• Esperienza nella gestione collaborativa di progetti con metodi BIM e pianificazione digitale

• Modo di lavorare indipendente e strutturato, oltre a forti capacità comunicative e di lavoro di squadra

• Ottime competenze orali e scritte di tedesco e buone competenze in inglese. La conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio, ma non un prerequisito

Diventa parte della storia di successo di AFRY! Offriamo libertà creativa e responsabilità personale, un'atmosfera di lavoro collegiale e internazionale, condizioni di lavoro moderne, modelli di lavoro flessibili, benefici sociali sopra la media, opportunità di sviluppo attraenti e generosa partecipazione all'abbonamento ai trasporti pubblici, oltre a una carta di viaggio a mezza tariffa per raggiungere facilmente i nostri moderni edifici d'uffici in zone centrali.
Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online!

			AFRY fornisce servizi di ingegneria, gestione di progetti e consulenza che supportano la transizione energetica e la trasformazione industriale e rafforzano la resilienza sociale. Con 18.000 esperti in tutto il mondo, uniamo la portata globale con competenze locali e una vasta conoscenza del settore per rendere sostenibile il futuro delle future generazioni.
Costruire il futuro

Informazioni aggiuntive
			In AFRY, creiamo cambiamento in tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché il cambiamento avviene solo quando idee audaci si uniscono. Quando lavoriamo insieme con successo, innoviamo e adottiamo prospettive diverse. È così che modelliamo il futuro. Cerchiamo attivamente candidati qualificati che vogliano far parte dei nostri team inclusivi e diversificati in tutto il mondo. Unisciti a noi per accelerare la transizione verso un futuro più sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Job Description
			Become part of our WATER & ENVIRONMENT team. We plan and implement wastewater treatment plants with state-of-the-art technologies for the further elimination of nutrients and the removal of organic trace substances. In addition, we minimise energy consumption, use wastewater as a resource and close material cycles for sustainable solutions. Support us in the project planning and implementation of wastewater treatment plants. Plan the sustainable infrastructure facilities of tomorrow with us, which contribute to improving the water quality in rivers and lakes and at the same time inspire our clients with innovative and customer-oriented solutions.
Take on responsibility with us as:
PROJECT MANAGER CIVIL ENGINEERING IN THE FIELD OF WATER & WASTEWATER 80-100% - ZURICH
Shape the water infrastructure of tomorrow
Wastewater treatment plants and urban drainage systems are among the most demanding infrastructure projects: they combine structural and civil engineering, structural engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering and building technology – often during ongoing operation and under high demands on quality, deadlines and costs.
At AFRY, you will play a central role in such projects. You will develop building concepts, coordinate interdisciplinary planning teams and accompany our customers from the initial idea to successful implementation.
You don't work alone: In our Water & Environment team, you will meet experienced specialists who share their knowledge, take responsibility and support each other.
YOUR TASKS:

• Planning and implementation of sophisticated building and civil engineering works and developing innovative and economical solutions for operators of wastewater treatment plants and urban drainage systems

• Take over the overall or sub-project management and control quality, costs, deadlines and risks

• Coordination of interdisciplinary project teams and lead the interfaces to structural engineering, process engineering, architecture, mechanical engineering, building technology and EI&C

• We advise and accompany our customers and represent the projects vis-à-vis building owners, authorities, planning parties and executing companies throughout all SIA planning phases
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

• A well-rehearsed and experienced team

• Complex projects with technical demands and impact

• Freedom for initiative and responsibility

• Interdisciplinary cooperation at eye level

• Promotion of your individual strengths

• Flexible and contemporary working models
YOUR PROFILE:

• Degree in civil engineering, architecture or a comparable field

• Several years of professional experience (at least 5 years) in the planning and implementation of infrastructure, industrial or building construction projects

• Experience ideally in the field of water and wastewater, in structural engineering, in structural engineering or in specialist construction management

• Interest in interdisciplinary issues and enjoyment of working with different departments

• Experience in collaborative project management with BIM and digital planning methods

• Independent, structured way of working as well as strong communication and teamwork skills

• Very good oral and written German skills and good English skills. Knowledge of French is an advantage, but not a prerequisite

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative freedom and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, modern employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in the public transport subscription as well as a Half-Fare travelcard so that you can easily reach our modern office buildings in central locations.
We look forward to receiving your online application!

Company Description
			AFRY provides engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen societal resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to make the future of future generations sustainable.
Making the Future

Additional information
			At AFRY, we create change in everything we do. Because change only happens when bold ideas come together. When we work together successfully, innovate and take different perspectives. That's how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates who want to become a part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

Vous ne travaillez pas seul : dans notre équipe Eau & Environnement, vous rencontrerez des spécialistes expérimentés qui partagent leurs connaissances, assument leurs responsabilités et se soutiennent mutuellement.
VOS TÂCHES :

• Planification et mise en œuvre de travaux sophistiqués de construction et d'ingénierie civile, ainsi que développement de solutions innovantes et économiques pour les exploitants des stations d'épuration des eaux usées et des systèmes de drainage urbain

• Prendre en charge la gestion globale ou du sous-projet et contrôler la qualité, les coûts, les délais et les risques

• Coordination des équipes de projets interdisciplinaires et direction des interfaces avec l'ingénierie des structures, l'ingénierie des procédés, l'architecture, le génie mécanique, la technologie du bâtiment et l'EI&C

• Nous conseillons et accompagnons nos clients et représentons les projets auprès des propriétaires de bâtiments, des autorités, des équipes de planification et des entreprises exécutantes tout au long de toutes les phases de planification de la SIA
CE À QUOI VOUS POUVEZ VOUS ATTENDRE DE NOUS :

• Une équipe bien rodée et expérimentée

• Projets complexes avec des exigences techniques et un impact

• Liberté d'initiative et de responsabilité

• Coopération interdisciplinaire à hauteur d'œil

• Promotion de vos forces individuelles

• Modèles de travail flexibles et contemporains
VOTRE PROFIL :

• Diplôme en génie civil, architecture ou dans un domaine comparable

• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle (au moins 5 ans) dans la planification et la mise en œuvre de projets d'infrastructures, industriels ou de construction

• Une expérience idéalement dans le domaine de l'eau et des eaux usées, en génie structurel, en génie structurel ou en gestion spécialisée de la construction

• Intérêt pour les questions interdisciplinaires et plaisir de travailler avec différents départements

• Expérience en gestion collaborative de projets avec BIM et méthodes de planification numérique

• Une manière de travailler indépendante et structurée ainsi que de solides compétences en communication et en travail d'équipe

• Très bonnes compétences orales et écrites en allemand ainsi qu'en anglais. La connaissance du français est un avantage, mais ce n'est pas un prérequis

Devenez partie intégrante de l'histoire à succès de l'AFRY ! Créer l'avenir

Rejoignez-nous pour accélérer la transition vers un avenir plus durable.

Job description
Become part of our team in CHUR.
The Chur location offers you the unique combination of global expertise and local team culture. They benefit from the resources and development opportunities of an international group and are at the same time part of a motivated, family-oriented team.
We manage, develop and plan infrastructure projects of all kinds. We accompany these projects from planning to implementation.

Take responsibility with us as:
JUNIOR BAULEITER:IN 80-100% - CHUR

• Processing of projects in road, railway and tunnel construction (new construction and repair)

• Taking over the role of local management in smaller projects

• Participation in construction meetings and gradual assumption of responsibility in construction management

• Support of the chief building management in large infrastructure projects

• Aid for the preparation of tenders

• Participation in site inspections, building acceptances and quality assurance processes

• Participation in construction meetings and gradual assumption of responsibility in construction management
Your opportunities:

• Personal and professional training, for example for construction management or project management

• Communicative, customer-oriented, cost-conscious and flexible personality

Become part of the AFRY success story! • Koordination der involvierten Fachbereiche zusammen mit den Teilprojektleitern und Fachspezialisten

• Abschluss als Ingenieur:in ETH oder FH in Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbar

jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung
			Mit einer Zeichner Lehre bei AFRY Schweiz AG stellst du die Weichen für deine berufliche Zukunft. Wir bieten dir eine abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Ausbildung in der spannenden Welt eines Ingenieurunternehmens.
Du erhältst während vier Jahren interessante Einblicke in verschiedene Fachbereiche und schliesst am Ende deine Lehre mit einem eidgenössischen Fähigkeitszeugnis ab.
Per August 2027 haben wir eine freie Lehrstelle an unserer Niederlassung in Winterthur:
ZEICHNER:IN MIT FACHRICHTUNG INGENIEURBAU - WINTERTHUR
Während der Ausbildung lernst du unter anderem die folgenden Tätigkeiten:

• Erstellen von digitalen Modellen und Plänen im Ingenieurhoch und -tiefbau (u.a. öffentliche Gebäude, Wohnhäuser, Strassen, Gleisbau, Kanalisation und Werkleitungen)

• Erstellen von digitalen Modellen und Plänen im Brückenbau (u.a. Strassen- und Bahnbrücken für Instandsetzung und Neubau)

• Ausseneinsätze und Baukontrollen in Zusammenarbeit mit Bauingenieur:innen

• Baustellenpraktikum von mind. 2 Wochen
Für die Lehrstelle bringst du vorzugsweise folgendes Profil mit:

• Abgeschlossene Volksschule (Sek A oder gute Sek B)

• Interessen / Stärken in Geometrie, Mathematik und Physik

• Freude am technischen Zeichnen und am präzisen Arbeiten

• Gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen

• Sicherer Umgang mit Computeranwendungen und Interesse an digitalen Arbeitsweisen

jobs.title: Junior Projektingenieur:in Leitungsbau 80-100% - Zürich
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung
			Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams Transmission & Distribution. Wir sind seit Jahrzehnten auf dem Gebiet der Planung von Anlagen zur Übertragung und Verteilung von elektrischer Energie tätig. Die Behandlung der dazugehörigen umweltrelevanten Aspekte rundet unsere Dienstleistungen ab.
Übernehmen Sie bei uns Verantwortung als: JUNIOR PROJEKTINGENIEUR:IN LEITUNGSBAU 80-100% - ZÜRICH
IHRE AUFGABEN:

• Unterstützung bei der fachtechnischen Bearbeitung von Projekten, z. B. bei einfachen Berechnungen, technischen Spezifikationen, Dokumentationen und Berichten.

• Mitarbeit bei der Planung von Leitungsbauprojekten – von der ersten Trassenfindung über vorbereitende Projektierungsaufgaben bis hin zur Begleitung späterer Projektphasen.

• Teilnahme an Abstimmungen mit internen Stellen und Begleitung von Kund:innen‑ oder Behördenterminen

• Zuarbeit beim Erarbeiten von Entscheidungsgrundlagen, z. B. durch Recherchen, technische Vergleiche oder Aufbereitung von Unterlagen.

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Termin‑ und Kostenübersichten sowie bei der Pflege projektbezogener Planungsunterlagen.
IHRE CHANCEN:

• Spannende und herausfordernde Projekte mit einem breiten und abwechslungsreichen Aufgabenfeld

• Sie arbeiten in einer wachsenden Organisation, für die Nachhaltigkeit und zukunftsorientierte Technologien wichtig sind

• Gezielte persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Maximal flexible Arbeitsweise mit der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens / Home-Office

• Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten mit neuester Infrastruktur an verkehrsgünstiger Lage beim Bahnhof Zürich-Altstetten

Qualifikationen
			IHR PROFIL:

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (FH/Uni) in Elektrotechnik, Bauingenieurwesen, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

• Erste praktische Einblicke (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudierendentätigkeiten oder Projektarbeiten) im Bereich Leitungsbau oder Energietechnik

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sowie Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse von Vorteil

jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung
			Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams WASSER & UMWELT. Wir begleiten Infrastruktur- und Energieprojekte mit dem Ziel, die Effizienz von Energie-, Wasser- und Stoffkreisläufen zu verbessern. Unterstützen Sie uns in der Projektierung und Realisierung von kommunalen und industriellen Abwasserreinigungsanlagen und Anlagen der Siedlungsentwässerung. Wir bearbeiten Leuchtturmprojekte auf Anlagen wie der ara region bern ag, STEP Aire Genève, ARA Frauenfeld, REAL ARA Buholz und viele mehr.
Planen Sie mit uns die nachhaltigen Infrastrukturanlagen von morgen, die zur Verbesserung der Wasserqualität in Flüssen und Seen beitragen und gleichzeitig durch innovative und kundenorientierte Lösungen unsere Bauherren begeistern.

Übernehmen Sie bei uns Verantwortung als:
PROJEKTLEITER:IN IM BEREICH WASSER & ABWASSER 80-100% – ZÜRICH
IHRE AUFGABEN:

• Gesamtverantwortliches Leiten von Projekten im Bereich der Abwasserreinigung oder der Siedlungsentwässerung

• Projektieren und Realisieren von verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen und Bauwerken im Industriestandard

• Erfolgreiches Führen von interdisziplinären Projektteams

• Beratung und Begleitung bestehender und neuer Kunden über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus (strategischen Planung bis Inbetriebnahme sowie Bewirtschaftung)

• Anwenden, Umsetzen und laufende Optimierung der BIM-Methodik
IHRE CHANCEN:

• Spannende Leuchtturm-Projekte im Bereich Infrastruktur, Umwelt- und Abwassertechnik

• Zusammenarbeit mit engagierten, motivierten und interdisziplinären Teams auch über den Standort Zürich hinaus

• Engagement in einem fortschrittlichen und nachhaltigen Unternehmen mit internationalem Netzwerk

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Gesamtprojektleitenden von anspruchsvollen Gross­projekten im Kläranlagenbau

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur Übernahme von Teamleitungsaufgaben
IHR PROFIL:

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium als Umwelt-, Bau- oder Kulturingenieur:in (ETH/FH)

• 5 bis 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Projektleiter:in und Projektingenieur:in, idealerweise in den Bereichen kommunale und industrielle Abwassertechnik inkl. Erfahrungen in der Fachbauleitung

• Erfahrungen in der kollaborativen Zusammenarbeit in BIM-Projekten

• Fundierte organisatorische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, welche sowohl im Team als auch im Kontakt mit Kunden und Partner zum Tragen kommen

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englisch- und/oder Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

jobs.title: Junior Projektingenieur:in Leitungsbau PLS-CADD 80-100% - Zürich
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung
			Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams Transmission & Distribution. Wir sind seit Jahrzehnten auf dem Gebiet der Planung von Anlagen zur Übertragung und Verteilung von elektrischer Energie tätig. Die Behandlung der dazugehörigen umweltrelevanten Aspekte rundet unsere Dienstleistungen ab.
Übernehmen Sie bei uns Verantwortung als: JUNIOR PROJEKTINGENIEUR:IN LEITUNGSBAU PLS-CADD 80-100% - ZÜRICH
IHRE AUFGABEN:

• Mitarbeit bei der fachtechnischen Bearbeitung von Leitungsbauprojekten, z. B. Unterstützung bei Plänen, einfachen Berechnungen, Dokumentationen und technischen Unterlagen.

• Unterstützung bei der Planung und Betreuung von Projekten im Leitungsbau – mit der Möglichkeit, sich Schritt für Schritt in die Anwendung von PLS‑CADD einzuarbeiten.

• Aufbereitung und Pflege von PLS‑CADD‑Modellen (z. B. Daten vorbereiten, erste Modellteile erstellen, Modellprüfungen unterstützen).

• Begleitung von Abstimmungen mit internen Ansprechpartner:innen sowie Teilnahme an Terminen mit Kunden oder Behörden

• Mitarbeit beim Zusammenstellen von Entscheidungsgrundlagen, z. B. Recherchen, Vergleichsübersichten, technische Zuarbeiten.
IHRE CHANCEN:

• Spannende und herausfordernde Projekte mit einem breiten und abwechslungsreichen Aufgabenfeld

• Sie arbeiten in einer wachsenden Organisation, für die Nachhaltigkeit und zukunftsorientierte Technologien wichtig sind

• Gezielte persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Maximal flexible Arbeitsweise mit der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens / Home-Office

• Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten mit neuester Infrastruktur an verkehrsgünstiger Lage beim Bahnhof Zürich-Altstetten

Job description
Become part of our TECHNICS & TECHNOLOGY team! Our mission is clear: we make transport safer, more sustainable and more efficient. With state-of-the-art operational and safety equipment (BSA), we ensure reliable transport routes. This ranges from reliable energy supply solutions to intelligent traffic control systems. In the ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING department, we combine innovative spirit with sound technical know-how. This is how we take electromechanical systems to a new level. Two strong teams are working together to develop sustainable solutions for complex infrastructure projects. Bring your experience to bear!

Take responsibility with us as:
BAULEITER: IN ELEKTRO 80-100% - AUSTRIA
ITS TASKS:

• Local construction management in the area of infrastructure installations in interdisciplinary construction projects

• Coordination and control of work on site in terms of quality, deadlines and costs

• Responsibility for acceptance processes and guarantee work

• Preparation of works such as scheduling, cost planning and tendering

• Conduct of infrastructure installation inspections
Your opportunities:

• Active contribution to diverse and important infrastructure projects that will shape Schweitz in the long term, including the north and west bypass of Zurich, the Kerenzerberg Tunnel and the Axenstrasse

• Variety through assignments at various project locations

• Possibility to actively contribute practical knowledge to execution planning and develop future-oriented solutions

• Flexible working models, home office and contemporary infrastructure at a central location

• Personal and professional development opportunities, for example as chief construction manager:in, project manager:in or project engineer:in

• Basic training as an electrical installer:in, automatic operator:in or network electrician:in

• Joy of responsibility and motivation to actively promote and shape projects

• Professional experience in the BSA environment or in comparable infrastructure areas is advantageous

• Good knowledge of relevant standards and regulations and relevant experience in the testing and commissioning of installations

• Team-oriented and communication-strong personality with a structured and independent working method

Become part of the AFRY success story! We offer creative leeway and personal responsibility, a collegial and international working atmosphere, contemporary employment conditions, flexible working models, above-average social benefits, attractive development opportunities and generous participation in public transport subscription as well as a half-tax so that you can reach our modern office buildings in a central location.

AFRY offers engineering, project management and consulting services that support the energy transition and industrial transformation and strengthen social resilience. With 18,000 experts worldwide, we combine global reach with local expertise and extensive industry knowledge to shape the future of future generations in a sustainable way.
Making the future

This is how we shape the future. We are actively looking for qualified applicants who want to become part of our inclusive and diverse teams around the world. Join us to accelerate the transition to a more sustainable future.

Making Future

Bei AFRY sorgen wir bei allem, was wir tun, für Veränderungen. Denn Wandel entsteht nur, wenn mutige Ideen zusammenkommen. Wir sind aktiv auf der Suche nach qualifizierten Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern, die ein Teil unserer integrativen und vielfältigen Teams auf der ganzen Welt werden möchten. Schließe Dich uns an, um den Übergang zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft zu beschleunigen.
